text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 127, March 30, 1948 ]
TRANSFERRING THE SEAT OF GOVERNMENT OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF LONGOS , PROVINCE
OF LAGUNA , FROM THE POBLACION OF LONGOS TO THE BARRIO OF SAN JUAN OF THE
SAME MUNICIPALITY.
Pursuant to the provisions of section sixty-eight of the Revised Administrative Code and upon the
recommendation of the municipal council of the municipality of Longos, Province of Laguna, the provincial
board of Laguna, and the Secretary of the Interior, the seat of government of the municipality of Longos is
hereby transferred from the poblacion of Longos to the barrio of San Juan of the same municipality.
Done in the City of Manila , this 30th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
forty-eight, and of the Independence of the Philippines , the second.
(Sgd.) MANUEL ROXAS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) EMILIO ABELLO
Chief of the Executive Office
